description: Revolve a sketch profile around an axis. With no axis given, the sketch's own construction line is used (see onshape_sketch_circle_axis); otherwise pass axis_ids or an axis query.

axis_ids.description: Deterministic ids of the axis entity.

elem.description: Element id (tab) — the <elem> segment of the document URL.

name.description: Feature name shown in the tree (default "Revolve").

op.description: NEW makes a new body; ADD/REMOVE/INTERSECT combine with existing bodies (default NEW).

sketch.description: Feature id of the sketch holding the profile.

type.description: FULL revolves all the way around (default FULL when an axis is given).

validate.description: Re-read the feature list afterwards and fail if the feature regenerated with an error (default true).

ws.description: Workspace id — the <ws> segment of the document URL.

name: onshape_revolve
title: Revolve a sketch
